title: A producer edits a shop that already exists

criteria.text: Owner edits image, name and about from one prefilled page
criteria.note: [V] Edit page Basics card prefills image, name and description (EditCards.tsx, #472, Reviewed by) and saves through group.update (#158, no Reviewed by line); deploy-health green on 1ebe680 and 614c920. Checked: EditCards.basics-whole.test.tsx (#1073, seen failing with the description dropped from the save) opens the sheet prefilled, saves image, name and about in one save and reads all three back on the public Page; its marker is `[guards F056.1 partial: image, name and about; the values line was cut]` since #1089, because socialus-plan's marker lint knows criterion 1, not the report's 1a; the part it leaves out is exactly 1b. Smoked: unknown. `page-edit` still has no `LIVE_PATHS` entry in `evals/smoke/live.spec.ts`, so no run opens the editor; `smoke-live` on `main` 2026-11-19 (05178ea) was green on `explore`, `page` and `you` only [V gh run view, grep 2026-11-20]. Since 2026-10-30 the editor changed twice without touching the Basics card: #1181 (2026-11-05) swapped the tag box for a Listed-under card and #1146 (2026-11-01) readable addresses; the whole-half check and its marker are still in `EditCards.basics-whole.test.tsx` and CI on `main` is green [V reread 2026-11-20]. #1006 is still open though its check merged.

criteria.text: A free-text values line on the same prefilled page
criteria.note: [V] no values field and no column; the 'Values & badges' card in EditCards.tsx is a 'Coming soon' placeholder (#465, planned not built). Conflict: the scenario's approved line and the 2026-09-07 ruling cut the values statement, yet the criterion text still names it. #16 was closed 2026-10-18 saying 'shop image, description and values are edited in the Page editor'; values are not. Routed to scope-scenario [V reread 2026-11-20] still no values column or field (grep `values_statement` over `src` and `supabase/migrations`: none).

Built in #158 (no Reviewed by line); #944 (Reviewed by) added stops to the same handler; deploy-health green on 1ebe680 and 0083294. #1181 (2026-11-05, Reviewed by) changed `update.ts` for the label set only; the active-owner check and the `group.updated` event are untouched [V reread 2026-11-20]. Smoked: unknown. `page-edit` still has no `LIVE_PATHS` entry in `evals/smoke/live.spec.ts`, so no run opens the editor; `smoke-live` on `main` 2026-11-19 (05178ea) was green on `explore`, `page` and `you` only [V gh run view, grep 2026-11-20]. unmarked: update.test.ts ('refuses a stranger', 'writes an event naming the fields that changed'). Check ticket #585

criteria.text: The values column has no source or provenance field; nothing but the owner's own edit can write it
criteria.note: [V] no values_statement column in supabase/migrations or src; tests/migrations-page-identity.test.ts asserts only that one migration does not add it. Same conflict as 1b: the values line is cut, so the column this guards does not exist. Routed to scope-scenario [V reread 2026-11-20] unchanged.

criteria.text: A tagline of at most 120 characters, separate from the description, on card, profile and link preview
criteria.note: [V] no tagline column in supabase/migrations, no field in group.update or Edit, nothing in the Page's generateMetadata. TileCard takes a tagline prop but OwnPages passes the description into it. Ticket #584, no milestone [V reread 2026-11-20] still no tagline column, field or metadata (grep `tagline`: only `TileCard`'s prop and unrelated pages); #584 is open.

criteria.text: A Page with every optional field empty renders correctly, with nothing nagging
criteria.note: [V] ShopPublicPage omits an empty description, placement line, map, Contact and badge (sections built in #472, reworked by #926 and #944, all with Reviewed by; deploy-health green on 614c920, d453170, 0083294). Checked: ShopPublicPage.test.tsx 'F056 criterion 5 — every optional field empty' `[guards F056.5]` (#1066, tightened by #1067; seen failing with an 'Add a description' line) renders a Page with description, photo, links, tags, contact and place all empty for a visitor, a member and the owner and matches no nag line; the owner's deliberate 'add your first product' prompt (#920) is allowed by the check, which settles the [A] from 2026-10-23. #1081 (Wonders, 2026-10-26) added a Wonders panel to ShopPublicPage after the check merged [A: CI on main stayed green]. Smoked: unknown, `smoke-live` opens the first Page Explore lists (green on `main` 2026-11-19), not one with every field empty. #845 is still open though its check merged.

criteria.text: On the draft or live Page, an address search resolves to real coordinates with a confirming pin before saving; an unresolvable address refuses loudly
criteria.note: [V] WhereFields + PinAdjustMap (#351, Reviewed by), 'Drop a pin' saves the map's coordinates (#441, Reviewed by); #944 (Reviewed by) rebuilt WhereFields as seven answers with 'Street address' keeping the search, pin and refusal; deploy-health green on 3492589, e79a69d, 0083294. With no map key the address is used as found and no map is drawn. Only #1302 (American spelling, 2026-11-16) touched src/components/locations since 2026-10-23 [V]. Smoked: unknown. `page-edit` still has no `LIVE_PATHS` entry in `evals/smoke/live.spec.ts`, so no run opens the editor; `smoke-live` on `main` 2026-11-19 (05178ea) was green on `explore`, `page` and `you` only [V gh run view, grep 2026-11-20]. unmarked: WhereFields.test.tsx ('says so when nothing matches the address'), PinAdjustMap.test.tsx, LocationPlaceFields.test.tsx. Check ticket #585

criteria.text: A neighbourhood or town from a seeded list covering MSA 40900 instead of an address; a neighbourhood-mode Page exposes no street address anywhere
criteria.note: [V] seeded boundaries (#350: 88 places, 165 neighbourhoods; no Reviewed by line); the pick in #351 and #468 (Reviewed by), now the 'Neighbourhood only' answer in #944 (Reviewed by); saves a neighborhoodId and no point (where-save.ts). deploy-health green on 32c0cdc, 3492589, d41939a, 0083294. Invariant: #944 and #926 added per-answer privacy tests ('an area-only Page never sends its exact point') but no standing guard over every surface that reads a Page's location (#586). #1038 (2026-10-24) made neighbourhood search read no MSA without touching the pick or where-save. Smoked: unknown. `page-edit` still has no `LIVE_PATHS` entry in `evals/smoke/live.spec.ts`, so no run opens the editor; `smoke-live` on `main` 2026-11-19 (05178ea) was green on `explore`, `page` and `you` only [V gh run view, grep 2026-11-20]. unmarked: where-save.test.ts, tests/boundaries-db.test.ts. Split from 7: the pin is 7b #1278 now reads a Page's address signed out "at the precision the owner chose (an area anchor is an area)" (`resolve-shop.ts`), so an area-only Page still sends no exact point; still no standing guard over every surface (#586) [V reread 2026-11-20].
